intent: Unit IS the surface 'history reload query internal call': read-only keyset-ordered entries of a session. PB-18 batch-load: one SessionAccessCheck ownership query then one byIdAndTenant page query on the pinned HistoryStore, rows grouped by Reactor bufferTimeout(chat.history.reload.batch-size, chat.history.reload.batch-timeout). Audits history reloaded through AuditPort. The published Flux<HistoryEntry> is consumed by downstream subscribers (out-of-process internal callers of the reload call).

methods.signature: Flux<HistoryEntry> reload(String sessionId, String userId, String tenantId, String afterTurnId, int afterSequence, int pageSize)
methods.semantics: pageSize clamped to at most 50; rejects blank sessionId, userId or tenantId
